transcript: No one will ever tell you this, but you must be patient when you're becoming someone you've never been. Of course, it's going to feel uncomfortable. You're stepping into a version of yourself that your body has no memory of. Your nervous system and subconscious only know how to survive through old patterns. The overthinking, the people pleasing, the shrinking of yourself so no one gets upset. So when you finally start choosing yourself, setting boundaries, speaking your truth, your system is going to freak out. It's going to tell you that you're selfish. It's going to try to pull you back into familiar chaos. Not because you're failing, but because your body has been trained to equate comfort with suffering. That's why change feels like danger. That's why healing feels like you're losing yourself. You're not. You're simply finally meeting the parts of you that never got to exist. So if you feel lost, confused, or doubtful, that's actually a good place to be. You're not going backwards. You're crossing the threshold into who you were meant to be. If this spoke to you, I created a 30-day healing journey that guides you step by step through this exact process. It's not just motivation. It's a real transformation. You can find it in my profile.
